title: Archived rows are dimmed to 60%, so their grey second line drops well below readable contrast
what_happens: The whole archived row has opacity 0.6 (measured). Its link name · date line is muted grey on card at 60%, about 2.5:1 by estimate from the colour tokens, under the 4.5:1 floor.
who_hurts: Admin looking for an archived session to reopen, especially on a bright screen.
suggested_fix: Keep the 'archived' tag and the separate Archived section, and drop opacity-60 (session-row.tsx:26), or dim only the title colour to text-muted-foreground.
